subject: Arcturus commercial request — liability carveouts, extended warranty & discount approval
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwoodinference.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwoodinference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Daniel Park <daniel@arcturushealth.com>, Maya Singh <msingh@arcturushealth.com>
Date: 2029-02-11T09:14:00-08:00
Subject: Arcturus — commercial ask + redlines (needs exec sign-off)

Hi team,

Quick summary from the Arcturus negotiation today. They sent redlines to both the CSA and SOW (attached). Key asks that are outside our standard policy:

- Unlimited liability for any data incidents (they cited patient safety concerns)
- Indemnity language expanded to include third-party claims even where customer processes are involved
- Warranty period: customer requests 24 months on uptime/service guarantees
- Commercial: asking for a 15% one-time discount and 12% ongoing seat discount if we don't agree to broader terms

They are requesting a final contract this week to hit their implementation window. Legal flagged the redlines as high-risk and asked we escalate to execs for authorization on liability/indemnity/warranty changes and any compression on list pricing.

Attachments: Arcturus_CSA_redlines.pdf, Arcturus_SOW_v3_redlines.docx

Proposed negotiation posture from sales: preserve firm liability cap, offer a time-limited warranty extension to 12 months, and consider a structured discount tied to a 24-month committed Dedicated capacity agreement.

Markus — can you confirm whether we can run an exec clearance or should we propose the compromise to the customer first? Jordan, please add any legal must-haves.

Thanks,
Marissa

--
Marissa Cole

From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwoodinference.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Daniel Park <daniel@arcturushealth.com>, Maya Singh <msingh@arcturushealth.com>
Date: 2029-02-11T11:02:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Arcturus — commercial ask + redlines (needs exec sign-off)

Markus / Marissa,

Thanks for the heads up. Quick legal read: the Arcturus redlines materially broaden our exposure. Primary concerns: the unlimited liability request and the indemnity wording that removes fault qualifiers. Those are non-starters for us without senior authorization.

Options we see that would be defensible and still keep the deal moving:
- Cap liability at $3,000,000 aggregate per year (customer requested unlimited).
- Limit warranty to 12 months for service levels; include service credits language rather than extended warranty remedies.
- Indemnity: accept customer-facing indemnity for third-party claims only where Redwood is at fault; retain exclusions for customer misuse and downstream system changes.
- Commercial concession: up to 10% one-time discount if customer signs a 24-month committed Dedicated capacity contract and pre-pays 6 months.

If execs want a narrower cap (e.g., $1.5M) or are open to a targeted carveout for patient-safety incidents, that is also a path — but legal needs explicit direction before we counter.

I drafted a short exec memo with the legal rationale and risk scoring (attached as part of the Exec_Memo_Arcturus.pdf). Recommend we escalate to Aditya for commercial approval and the CEO if we go above $3M.

Jordan

--
Jordan Blake
Director, Legal — Commercial Contracts
From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwoodinference.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwoodinference.com>, Daniel Park <daniel@arcturushealth.com>, Maya Singh <msingh@arcturushealth.com>
Date: 2029-02-11T17:38:00-08:00
Subject: FW: Arcturus — commercial ask + redlines (needs exec sign-off)

Aditya,

Bringing this to you for a fast decision. Summary: Arcturus (healthcare, pilot next quarter) is pressing for unlimited liability and extended warranty (24 months) and wants a 15% discount. Legal recommends the following compromise that requires exec sign-off:

1) Liability cap: $3,000,000 aggregate per year
2) Warranty: 12 months with service credit remedy language (no extended warranty remedies)
3) Indemnity: Redwood indemnifies for third-party claims only where Redwood is negligent; exclude customer misuse and alterations
4) Commercial: up to a 10% one-time implementation discount if Arcturus commits to a 24-month Dedicated contract and 6 months prepay

If you approve, Marissa will present the counter. If not, please indicate acceptable cap/terms or if this needs CEO sign-off. Time is sensitive — customer expects language this week. I've attached the Exec_Memo_Arcturus.pdf that Jordan prepared.

Thanks,
Markus

--
Markus Klein
Head of Sales, Enterprise Accounts
markus_klein@redwoodinference.com
From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Daniel Park <daniel@arcturushealth.com>, Maya Singh <msingh@arcturushealth.com>
Date: 2029-02-12T16:02:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Arcturus — commercial ask + redlines (needs exec sign-off)

Markus / team,

I reviewed Jordan's memo and the proposed compromise. I approve the compromise as outlined below — conditional on the commercial contingency. Please proceed to present this counter to Arcturus.

Approved terms:
- Liability cap: $3,000,000 aggregate per year.
- Warranty: 12 months; remedy = service credits only.
- Indemnity: Redwood indemnifies for third-party claims where Redwood is at fault; maintain exclusions for customer misuse.
- Discount: up to 10% one-time implementation discount conditioned on a 24-month Dedicated commitment and 6 months prepay. No additional recurring seat discount.

Operational asks:
- Finance to validate the ARR impact and revenue recognition for the prepay terms.
- Contracts to prepare a redline reflecting the above; include a clause limiting aggregate exposure and a mutual SLA credits framework.
- Deal Desk to update HubSpot (ARC-2029-04) to reflect the final commercial.

If Arcturus insists on unlimited liability or 24-month warranty remedies beyond credits, escalate to the CEO. Otherwise, give Marissa the go-ahead.

Aditya
